title: Touchscreen Dependence
text: Many vehicle functions rely heavily on the center touchscreen.

title: Firm Ride
text: Some reviewers still describe the ride as firm.

title: No Native CarPlay
text: Tesla vehicles do not provide native Apple CarPlay or Android Auto integration.

title: Interior Rattle Reports
text: Some owners report occasional rattles or trim noises.

title: Paint Chip Reports
text: Some owners report paint chips on exposed exterior surfaces.

title: FSD Requires Supervision
text: Full Self-Driving Supervised requires an attentive driver and does not make the vehicle autonomous.

title: Flush Door Handles
text: Flush exterior door handles can require some adaptation.

title: Automatic Wiper Reports
text: Some owners report inconsistent automatic windshield-wiper behavior.

title: Charging Planning
text: Long-distance EV travel may require more charging planning than gasoline vehicle travel.
